title: Marugame Udon
summary: Excited to have delivered the fit-out for Marugame Udon, crafting a modern, welcoming space that reflects the brand’s authentic Japanese dining experience. From custom joinery and finishes to lighting and layout planning, every detail was thoughtfully executed to ensure a functional kitchen, smooth operations, and a comfortable, inviting environment for guests to enjoy.

approval.note: Client confirmed MENAARC holds the rights to present this project. Source archive: righteousgrp.com.
